Commentary.Commentary: It won't be an easy task for the hosts as the track is expected to slow down a touch in the second half. Bangladesh will be backing themselves to defend this target. Expect an absorbing contest as the series is on the line. Join us shortly after the break.

The Windies pacers were off the radar and hence, proved to be insipid today. The spin duo of Ashley Nurse and Devendra Bishoo came to their recuse in the middle overs, only conceding 95 runs in their 20 overs and also shared three wickets between them. However, a breezy knock from Mahmudullah at the fag end gave Bangladesh the momentum they wished for. The entertaining innings from Mashrafe Mortaza was also instrumental in powering them to their highest total against Windies. The visitors looted 42 from the last three overs, thereby finishing on a high.

A strong finish from Bangladesh has propelled them over 300, which is quite a good total regardless of the surface. Tamim Iqbal stole the limelight as he scored a brilliant ton, which also happened to be his second in this series. He took his time initially and once he got his eye in, he played some eye-catching strokes. He stitched some useful partnership, the most notable being the 81 with Shakib Al Hasan.
Full length ball, angling in, heaved away through wide mid on for a couple. BANGLADESH FINISH ON 301/6.
Another off pace ball on middle and leg, pulled aerially towards deep square leg for a couple.
Full ball around off, hit down towards long off for a quick run. Later the replay showed that if the throw had hit the bull's eye at the bowler's end, Hossain would have been a goner.
FOUR! The slower ball doesn't work for Paul. Hossain reads it well and swipes the length ball through mid-wicket for a rocketing boundary.
Slower short ball on leg stump, pulled away to deep backward square leg for a single.
Fullish ball, Hossain makes space for himself and drills it to wide long on to change strike.

FOUR! 19 runs off the over, just the momentum the visitors need at the fag end. On a length outside off, Mahmudullah waits for it and guides it late through third man to pick up another boundary. He moves onto 66 from 48.
SIX! In the arc, out of the park! Fullish ball on off, Mahmudullah comes down the track with intent and tonks it over long on to clear the fence.
Mosaddek Hossain is the new man in.

OUT! Sabbir departs against the run of play! Good length ball well outside off, Rahman throws the kitchen sink at it, aiming to heave it across the line but only manages to get a top edge. The ball skies towards the point region where Evin Lewis is safe as a house.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Back of a length ball on middle, Sabbir heaves it uppishly through mid-wicket to find the ropes one more time.
FOUR! Poor delivery and duly punished! Full ball which is too straight. The around the wicket angle is the icing on the cake. Rahman swipes it over short fine leg to pick up another boundary.
Cottrell goes wide of the crease and bowls a full ball in line of the stumps. Mahmudullah squeezes it through mid-wicket for a single.
Mahmudullah tucks the length ball around the corner for a single. 11 from this over.
SIX! Reaches his 19th ODI fifty in style does Mahmudullah! He uses his feet to a fullish ball and smokes it over long on for a biggie. It has been a good knock. He will be aiming to finish strong.
Wide! The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. Wide signalled by the umpire.
The slower ball trend continues. This time Sabbir pulls it nicely to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Another off pace delivery outside off, Mahmudullah tries to work it to the leg side but gets a leading edge towards point. A run is stolen.
Slower ball on the pads, tucked towards the man at 45 for an easy single.
Short ball in line of the stumps, Sabbir ducks under it.
Change of ends for Keemo Paul.
Good change of pace from Cottrell, Mahmudullah plays an agricultural slog but misses. 6 from the over.
Slower ball outside off, Rahman drags the heave to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On a length outside off, Mahmudullah guides it to third man to change strike.
Served well outside off, sliced away over backward point for a couple.
On a fullish length outside off, Sabbir goes for a heave but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The batsmen steal another quick run.
Low full toss outside off, the batsman drives it towards extra cover for a brisk single.
Outside off, Sabbir swings at it but misses. A wicket and 2 from the over.
Sabbir Rahman comes out to bat.

OUT! Mortaza's entertaining knock comes to an end! His opposite number, Holder, who has been pretty expensive so far, will breathe a sigh of relief. Mortaza makes room and Jason spots that. He follows him with a short ball. Mashrafe tries to ramp it over Gayle at short third man but has no pace to work with. Ends up finding the big man to perfection. End of a breezy stand, 53 from 42 to be precise. Can Bangladesh capitalize on it at the fag end?
Straying on the hips, Mahmudullah swipes it to fine leg for a run.
On a length going down the leg side, goes past Mahmudullah's flick , brushes his pads and reaches the keeper on the bounce.
Shortish ball on middle and leg, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length ball well outside off, Mortaza goes for a fancy reverse pull shot but misses.
Low full toss on the stumps, hit down to long off for a run.

Very full ball outside off, squeezed out to third man to rotate strike. That brings up the 50-run stand between the duo. It has come only from 36 balls. Mortaza promoting himself up the order has worked so far. 250 is also up for Bangladesh.
FOUR! Another streaky boundary! Full ball wide outside off, Mahmudullah throws his bat at it but gets it off the outer half of the bat through third man to find the fence.
The batsman has driven it straight down the ground. They pick up a single.
FOUR! No matter how they come as long as they keep on coming. Full ball outside off, Mortaza throws the kitchen sink at it but gets an outside edge past the keeper to find the fence.
Yorker outside off, a swing and a miss from Mortaza.

Innovation at it's best but could have costed him his wicket as well. Fearless Mortaza looks to play the reverse hit from his crease. Seeing this, Holder changes his length and bangs it in. Mortaza still goes after it and gets a top edge. Hope behind the stumps hops but can't hold onto the catch. It was a difficult chance but could've changed Windies fortunes with Mortaza's wicket. One run taken in the end.
Shortish on the pads, played nicely to the leg side. One run added to the total.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.
In line of the stumps, punched off the back foot for a run.
Short on the pads, Mortaza misses an opportunity here. He fails to connect and then punches his bat in anguish.

SIX! Mortaza has Holder's number. He is relentless on the opposition skipper. Mortaza gets an off cutter outside off, he moves across and lofts it handsomely towards long on. The ball goes just over the fielder stationed there and into the fence.
Rocks on the back foot and slaps it down the ground for another run. The run rate is getting better and better.
Mahmudullah plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. They pick up a single.

FOUR! Intelligent stuff from Paul but unfortunately he can't stop this one for going to the boundary. Seeing Mahmudullah staying on the leg side, he bowls it full outside off. The batsman flashes hard at it and gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies over the short fine leg fielder and races to the boundary.
Hangs back and punches it through mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
It's been driven superbly to the fielder at covers. No run taken.
Mahmudullah stays on the back foot and powers it through covers for a run.
In line of the stumps, tucked to the on side for a single. A much needed over to give Bangla Tigers a boost. 16 runs came off this over.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. They pick up a single.

In the air... but evades Gayle at fine leg easily. A change up from Holder. He bangs this one on middle and Mortaza pulls it. A top edge is found and it goes towards deep backward square leg. Gayle gingerly goes to the ball and keeps the batsmen to two.

FOUR! It feels like he just reloaded his gun and pushed the trigger to the full ball. Holder is giving out easy options to Mortaza who is making the most of it. This time he lofts it over the bowler's head and earns three back-to-back boundaries.

FOUR! Holder misses the yorker again and Mortaza once again makes him pay. This time it's much more classy from him. He makes room for himself and drives it along the carpet through extra cover for another boundary.
FOUR! Brutal! Captain to captain stuff and Mortaza wins the battle this time. A full ball on middle, punched off the back foot down the ground for a boundary.
Jason Holder is back on.
Again full outside off, punched off the front foot for nothing.
Full around off, Mortaza thuds it into the pitch and it bounces over Paul. One run taken.
On the pads, worked to the leg side for a run.
Outside off, too full, Mahmudullah gets a bottom edge which goes to the keeper on the bounce.

Was there an inside edge? Perhaps that is what saved him there. A fuller ball on middle and leg, Mahmudullah takes a few steps forward to flick but misses. An appeal is ensued but the umpire ignores it.
Gets behind the line of the ball and keeps it out off the front foot.
Powerplay 3 is into effect now. 5 fielders are allowed outside the inner circle. Also, Keemo Paul is back on.
A pinpoint yorker, tailing in. Mortaza tries to clip it away but is hit on the pads. An appeal from the Windies players but the umpire stays put. It was sliding down leg.
Attacking the rib cage of the batsman with a shortish ball, tucked to the leg side for a run.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full ball on the pads, helped through mid on for a single.
On a length on middle, stays a bit low. Mortaza tucks it through square leg to rotate strike.
How did that miss the off stump? On a length around off, angling in. Mortaza tries to chop it away but gets beaten.
Jason Holder returns.
Mortaza opens his account and works the flatter ball on leg to the on side. One run taken.
Mashrafe Mortaza promotes himself to no. 6. Bangladesh are going at a good pace and the skipper wants to make the most of it. Would be eager to display his big-hitting prowess.

OUT! Gone! What a tame end to such a terrific innings from Tamim! He looks to flick it through square leg. The ball is on middle and leg which should have made it easier for him to play it comfortably. However, he finds Powell there who dives to his right and completes the catch. Can Windies make the most of this dismissal?
Rocks back and punches it off the back foot to wide mid on. One run taken.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Tossed up on off, driven to long off for a brace.
Sweeps the fuller ball straight to the fielder at short fine leg.
Driven through mid on by Mahmudullah. 10 runs came off this over and Bangladesh are motoring along.
On the pads, flicked through square leg for a brace.

SIX! Bang! Mahmudullah has powered it like a bullet over the long off fence. It feels as if he wanted to gift something to his partner for the century. He gets a floated ball on off and just pulls the trigger off the front foot to get the maximum.

11th ODI ton for the southpaw and his second in this series, he is having a great time. Nurse bowls a flighted ball on off and Tamim milks it down to long off to take the awaited single. It has been a brilliant innings. He has timed the ball so well to get himself to this stage and now looks like a ticking bomb about to explode any time. Not good signs for the Windies. Out of his last 10 centuries, 7 have resulted in a win for Bangladesh. Can this be the 8th victory for the Bangla Tigers?
Gets back and punches it through point for a run.
Full on off, driven through covers for nothing.
Gets behind the line of this flighted delivery and blocks it. He stays on 99.
In line of the stumps, flicked through the on side. One run added to the total.
Goes back to play the shortish ball towards point but fails to find the gap.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
SIX! Beautiful! He is enjoying this purple patch. A flighted ball on a length, Tamim slogs it nonchalantly over the square leg fence for a maximum. He moves to 98 with this.
Wide! Wide down the leg side, the batsman leaves it alone.
Loopy ball outside off, pushed to mid off. One run taken.
Shortish in line of the stumps, tucked to mid-wicket for a run. 4 singles off this over.
On the pads again, flicked to fine leg for another easy single.
Straighter one outside off, Mahmudullah cuts it through point for a run.
On leg, swept straight to the short fine leg fielder.
Makes some room to play the flighted ball. He gets it through covers and changes strike.
Shortish delivery pushed back to the bowler for nothing.
Pushes it to Gayle at slip for no run.
Well bowled! Bishoo pushes Mahmudullah back in his crease with a flatter ball on off. It lands and spins away from the face of the batsman's bat.
Tamim flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Slower ball on a length, easily tucked to the on side for an easy single.
On the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Pushed through by Bishoo on middle, Iqbal drives it to mid on for no run.
Drinks! Tamim Iqbal has set a nice platform for his team to blast in the last few overs. They have wickets in hand as well and Mahmudullah looks in good touch too.
FOUR! Cheeky stuff from Mahmudullah. He moves inside the line of the ball and paddles it fine for a boundary.
Tossed up outside off, driven through covers for a run.
Slower ball outside off, Tamim guides it to the short third man fielder for no run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter around off, tucked through cover-point by Tamim for a couple.

Wide and Not out! Iqbal didn't come out of his crease at all. It is a faster delivery down the leg side from Nurse and Tamim misses the flick. The keeper removes the bails in a jiffy and an appeal ensues. The square leg umpire refers it upstairs. The replays suggest that Iqbal never moved his back foot out of the crease.
A stumping appeal against Tamim Iqbal has been sent upstairs. Seems to be safe.
Outside off, Tamim fails to get bat to ball.
Slow on middle and leg, flicked by Iqbal for another single.
Iqbal flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Shortish in line of the stumps, Tamim goes back and punches it back to the bowler.
Spinning into the pads of Tamim, tucked to short fine leg for no run.
Flighted on middle,  driven through mid on by Mahmudullah. They pick up a single.
Slower one spinning away from the right-hander, pushed to point.
Devendra Bishoo is back on.
Flat and quick, kept out off the front foot.
Fullish delivery, knocked down to long on to rotate strike.
Waits for this one and dabs it late to short third man for a single.
The batsman drives this through the covers. They pick up a single.

FOUR! Streaky way to get off the mark! Straighter one from Nurse. Mahmudullah plays for the non-existent run and gets an outside edge. Gayle at first slip is a bit lazy and the ball goes past him. He chases it but only comes second best.
Mahmudullah strides out to bat.

OUT! A poor shot selection and he has paid the price for it! There was no need to attempt something so cheeky as the runs were flowing from the other end. Rahim shuffles a long way across his stumps thereby exposing them. Nurse does the smart thing of bowling a tossed up ball in line of the stumps. Mushfiqur tries to paddle scoop it over short fine leg but misses it completely to find a bail behind him disturbed. Bangladesh have lost another important wicket. They need to be a bit careful going forward in this innings.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, swiped away to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Innovative! The execution is spot on too. Slower ball from Keemo. Tamim reads it well and scoops it over backward square leg to pick up another boundary. He is pacing his knock nicely here.
Full ball outside off, stroked off the front foot to sweeper cover for a couple.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

FOUR! Iqbal has made his intentions clear now. His shot selections have been good as well. Good length ball around off, Tamim comes down the track and flat-bats it past the bowler. It races through mid off and reaches the fence.
Straying on the pads, helped through square leg for a single.
Keemo Paul returns for a bowl.
Iqbal makes room but doesn't have space to work with. Ends up pushing it back to Nurse.
On a flatter trajectory, kept out watchfully.
Comes right forward to the pitch of the ball to place it through mid off for a run.
Quicker through the air, turned with the spin to mid-wicket.
Full ball on middle and leg, knocked down to long on for a run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Good length ball outside off, run down to third man for a run.

Close shave! Similar length ball on middle, Tamim pulls it away towards deepish mid on to set off for a run. Powell comes in from the deep, picks up the ball and aims at the bowler's end but fails to hit the bull's eye. The replay shows that if that would've hit, Tamim was a goner. Really difficult to find your target from such a long range though.
Back of a length ball, angling in sharply. Iqbal tries to tuck it away but gets hit on the thigh pad.
Iqbal looks to tap and turn by playing this ball towards backward point but he is rightly sent back by his partner.
SIX! Clean as a whistle! He has spent a lot of time at the crease and now he has the license to free his arms. In the arc for Tamim. He leans ahead and tonks it over long off to clear the fence.
Full length ball attacking the stumps, Iqbal whips it uppishly through mid-wicket and comes back for a brace.
On a flatter trajectory outside off, tapped past point for a run.
Fullish ball on the pads, swept away towards square leg.
Shorter in length, played with an angled bat towards point.
The batsman has driven it straight down the ground.
Wide! Drifting down the leg side, Tamim misses his sweep.
Mushfiqur eases this one down to long off for a run.
SIX! That is confidence for you! Beginning right from where he left off in the previous game. Rahim uses his feet and lifts the tossed up ball nonchalantly over long on for a maximum.
A well-directed bouncer on middle and leg, Iqbal shapes for the pull but bails out of it rightly.
Full length ball, defended solidly off the front foot.
Wide! The batsman tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Poor! Full ball outside off, Rahim taps it towards point. There is an unnecessary throw at the bowler's end and there is no one backing up. Hence, a run results.
Beaten! Off cutter from Cottrell, Rahim goes for a booming drive but the ball whizzes past his outside edge.
In the corridor of uncertainty, Rahim plants his front foot forward to let it be.
Fractionally overpitched outside off, Iqbal caresses it to sweeper cover for a single.
Sheldon Cottrell is back on.
Spinning into Mushfiqur who tucks it towards mid-wicket. A wicket maiden for Nurse.
Rahim leans ahead nicely and blocks this one with authority.
Slow through the air, kept out watchfully.
Mushfiqur Rahim comes out to bat.

OUT! Nurse strikes! The dangerous Shakib departs. He was getting a bit restless and he has finally perished. Tossed up ball on middle and leg, turning away. Shakib takes the risk of playing against the spin. He connects with his slog sweep nicely and the ball is traveling with the wind as well. However, the placement is not good. Keemo Paul at deep square leg takes a couple of steps in front and pouches it safely. The 81-run stand has been broken. The Windies will be eager to keep chipping away at the wickets.
Uses his feet to the tossed up ball and drives it back to the bowler.
Flighted delivery outside off, Shakib eases it towards mid off.
Slower through the air outside off, tapped off the front foot to covers.
Shortish delivery, punched to deep point for a run.
Wide! Gayle has been off radar as he slips this one down the leg side. Shakib lets it go this time.
Coming with the angle, turned around the corner for a single.
Shakib plays the tossed up ball off the inner half the bat towards square leg. A run taken.
Iqbal rocks back and punches this hard towards Gayle. He gets his fingertips to it to slow down the ball. But he can't stop the run.
On a flatter trajectory on middle, Shakib turns it towards the man at 45 for a run.
Wide! Down the leg side, Shakib tries to sweep it but misses.
Makes room to play the flighted ball through covers but can't pierce the gap.
In line of the stumps, defended.
Driven through mid-on by Shakib. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Slower around off, it spins and takes the outside edge of the bat to the third man region. No harm done.
On the pads, worked to the on side with a wristy shot for another run.
Floated on middle, driven to long on for a run.
In line of the stumps, Iqbal uses his feet but decides to pad it away.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Iqbal uses his feet and drives this down to long on for a run.
FOUR! Shoddy work! Loopy ball, Tamim uses his feet and drills it towards long off. Holder there reaches it but makes a meal of it to concede a boundary.
Tossed up ball, eased back to the bowler.

Run out chance missed! Shakib must have had his heart in his mouth! Shorter ball, stops on the pitch a bit. Shakib tries to force it off the back foot through the off side but ends up mistiming it uppishly to the right of Gayle. Bishoo goes after it from short extra cover and picks up the ball as the batsmen attempt a run. Shakib is struggling as the throw comes in but it goes over the stumps at the non-striker's end. The replay shows that Shakib was miles out had Bishoo found his target. Perhaps Gayle could have positioned himself behind the stumps as well. Not good game awareness from the veteran and a result, Shakib Al Hasan survives.

Good fielding! Slower through the air in line of the stumps, Tamim goes down the track and makes some room to play it inside out over covers. Cottrell in the deep hares to his left, collects the ball and seems to have stopped it. The umpires check for it upstairs but he is fine. Two runs taken.
Stump-to-stump line, driven back to the bowler.
Shorter in length, milked down to long on for a single.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.

43rd ODI fifty for Tamim Iqbal! Floated delivery, Iqbal works it through square leg for a couple. The veteran has been in some good form and he needs to make the best of it. Would be eyeing a big one now.
Full delivery around off, knocked down to long off for a run.
Straighter one from Bishoo, Shakib glides it past backward point for a single. Wants another run but is rightly sent back.
Shorter in length, dealt from the back foot.
This time Shakib turns the tossed up ball towards short fine leg.
Allows the ball to spin into him and tucks it around the corner to change strike.
That one stayed low! Bowls this one flatter and quicker outside off, turning in. Iqbal just about manages to keep it out.
Slow through the air on middle and off, eased towards mid-wicket.
On a flatter trajectory in line of the stumps, Shakib dead-bats it. 2 from Nurse's first over.
Full ball on the pads, whipped to deep mid-wicket to rotate strike.
Shakib makes use of the depth of the crease to punch this one down to long on for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Play and a miss! Shorter in length, Shakib shapes to cut it but misses. That just missed the outside edge.
Quicker through the air on off, kept out watchfully.
Ashley Nurse to roll his arm over now.
Plays this one with the spin to the leg side.
FOUR! Shot! Tossed up on off, Iqbal shuffles a touch and sweeps it past short fine leg to pick up another boundary. With his shot, he brings up the 50-run stand between the two as well.
The batsman drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.
A touch shorter in length, forced off the back foot to sweeper cover for a run.
Wide! Spinning down the leg side, Tamim goes for the slog sweep but misses.
Slow through the air, dealt nicely off the front foot.

Close shave! Bishoo could have converted that into a catch. Tossed up ball in line of the stumps, Shakib comes down the track but he is not quite to the pitch of it. Ends up mistiming it towards Bishoo. He gets low to his left but the ball goes just under his hands and towards long on. A run taken. Bishoo should have done better.
Back of a length outside off, tapped to third man for a run. 10 from the over.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! That will give the all-rounder a lot of confidence. Typical response from the bowler as he drags his length back. It sits up nicely for Shakib as he pulls it with aplomb through mid-wicket to find the fence.
FOUR! Beautiful! Slightly overpitched outside off, Shakib comes forward and drives it crisply past mid off for an exquisite boundary.

In the air... but safe! Rush of blood from Tamim. Some tight overs have caused him to do so. Iqbal pre-meditates as he uses his feet. Paul spots that and bowls it short outside off. Tamim goes through with his pull shot but ends up top edging it towards third man. The fielder there runs to his right but can only collect it on the bounce. A run taken.
On a length around off this time, Iqbal comes forward confidently and blocks it with his bat and pad close together.
Tight stump-to-stump line, Tamim leans ahead to dead-bat it.
Waits for this one and taps it towards cover-point for a single.
Quicker ball on the pads, played straight to the man at square leg.
Gets right forward to that one and tucks it towards mid-wicket for an easy run.
Bishoo shortens his length and there is ample time for Tamim to punch it through covers. A run taken.
Fuller in length, eased through mid off to rotate strike.
Shortish ball, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Drinks!
Short outside off, worked through cover-point by Shakib for another easy single. 4 singles off the over.
Fuller around off, driven down the ground for a run.
Driven to mid on by the batsman.
Oooh! Extra bounce in the pitch coming into action. A short of a length ball outside, it pitches and just kicks off from there. Shakib is beaten due to the bounce.
On a length outside off, Tamim edges it to third man for another run.
A back of a length ball outside off, played through covers for a single.
Iqbal uses his feet and drives this one towards Bishoo who picks up the ball and throws it towards the keeper. Tamim has to hurry back. No harm done in the end. A maiden from Bishoo, good stuff.
Spinning into Iqbal who turns it to the leg side.
Leans a touch and taps this one towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball, defended solidly off the front foot.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.

Not out! Safe on both counts. The review goes down the drain for the Windies. Tossed up ball outside off, Iqbal leans ahead to defend but seems to have missed it. The ball appears to have gone off the pads towards the first slip fielder who takes it and claims the catch. However, the umpire is not convinced. A few Windies player get into a discussion and convince their skipper to signal for the 'T' to which he agrees. Time for the replays. The Snicko doesn't detect any edge. The third umpire checks for the LBW now. Time for the Hawk Eye. The impact is outside off and that puts the argument to bed.

Windies feel that they have got the better of Tamim Iqbal. Holder has a look at his mates and signals for the DRS. There are two questions to be answered. Is there glove involved or will the LBW come into play?

Keemo is intent on bowling the short balls. He bangs in another one on middle and Tamim pulls it through deep back ward square leg. One run added to the total and 8 off this one. Bangladesh cruising along nicely.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Shakib guides the angled ball towards third man for a single.
Pulls another shortish ball to deep mid-wicket for a single. 6 runs of the first 3 balls.
FOUR! Up & over. Easy picking for Tamim. Another shortish ball outside off, Iqbal throws his bat it off the back foot and gets it over point fielder for a boundary.
Works the shortish ball to third man and changes strike.
Keemo Paul replaces Jason Holder.
Pushed to the cover region by Shakib. They pick up a single.

Uuf! So close. Bishoo tosses this up on middle and gets it to leg spin. Tamim goes after it with hard hands as he is beaten by the flight. He gets it through wide mid on but for a moment, the ball went aerially towards Hetmyer at short mid-wicket who took a couple of steps to his right and put in a dive. The ball went past him in a flash. A run is taken.
Driven towards the mid on region. One run added to the total.
Slower on middle, flicked off the pads by Tamim for another run.
Sweeps the flighted ball on leg and changes strike.
Shortish ball in line of the stumps, punched off the back foot to mid on. A run taken.
Works this one to the on side for another run. 9 runs off this over.
Wide! The batsman watches the bouncer go way above his head. The umpire signals a wide.

Holder misses his line this time and bowls it on the pads. Tamim flicks it through the square leg region. The ball races towards the boundary but is cut off by Keemo Paul who runs from the fine leg region to reach it. Two runs taken.

Almost another superb boundary for Shakib there. A fuller ball with some room on offer, he drives it through covers and a dive from Powell at mid off keeps it down to a run. Shakib is looking in ominous touch already.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

FOUR! Cracker! Goodness gracious! How good is that shot? A gentle length ball around off, Shakib lines it up and meets the ball with a straight bat. The followthrough on the shot is enough to tell the story there. The ball goes over the bowler's head and races to the boundary.

No run, no run shouts Shakib. A ball around off and it takes off from there. The batsman looks to defend it but the bounce means it hits him on his gloves. Iqbal sets off for a run but his partner isn't interested.

Confusion but no harm done! Tamim taps this one towards covers and looks for a run but he is rightly sent back by his partner. Makes his crease before the throw from the fielder reaches the keeper. Good start from Bishoo, only 1 from the over.
Iqbal shuffles a touch and plays the tossed up ball with soft hands towards short mid-wicket.
On a flatter trajectory, pushed off the back foot back to the bowler.
Shakib is off the mark! Works this one with the spin through square leg to rotate strike.
Fractionally short outside off, Shakib chops it towards the man at short cover.
Flatter ball on middle and leg, tucked towards mid-wicket.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. 4 fielders are permitted to stay out the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Also, Devendra Bishoo comes in to bowl.
Hangs back and lets it be. End of a successful over for Holder on the cusp of second Powerplay.
Tamim has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a brace.
Shakib Al Hasan is the next batsman in.

OUT! Gone! Finally the ball has found a pair of hands before bouncing on the turf. Holder bangs it in the middle of the track and rushes the right-hander. Haque goes after it with a pull but only manages to sky it towards mid on. Powell takes a couple of steps to his right and takes the catch easily. The breeze perhaps stopped the ball from going over Powell there. Anyway, a wicket for the Windies. Bangladesh lose their first in the last over of Powerplay 1.
Comes down the track this time with some intent and drives it through covers. Powell there runs to his right and puts in a dive to keep them under one.
On middle and leg, defended to the on side by Tamim.
Fuller ball outside off, Haque lunges forward and defends it.
Shortish around off, pushed to the off side by Haque.
On a length around off, it not that short but Haque still goes for the pull and misses. It hits him on his thigh pad for nothing.
On the pads, flicked through vacant mid-wicket region. Another run.
A shortish delivery in line of the stumps, tucked to the on side for a run by Anamul.
That ball has struck Haque on the thigh-pad as he misses to get it away.
Presents the full face of the bat and blocks it nicely. A decent start for the visitors.
On the pads, flicked through mid-wicket another run.
Fullish around off, defended.
Hangs back and keeps the length ball out easily.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.

In the air... safe again! A rash shot from Iqbal this. He dances down the track to play the length ball. He puts a lot of power into it but ends up skying it up towards long off. Powell runs backwards to but can't reach it in time. A brace taken in the end.
On a length on off, blocked off easily by Haque.
Around off, kept out.
Tamim has punched the ball off the back foot. The batsmen have run through for a single.

In the air... and safe! Out of nowhere, chance is produced. A back of a length ball on the hips, Iqbal looks to flick it fine but it goes off the top edge and just lobs in the air. It goes towards short fine leg. The keeper looks to get to it but can't. No harm in the end.
On a length again in line of the stumps, pushed to the on side for nothing.
An effort ball this on off. Tamim punches it to mid on.
Defended off the back foot by Tamim.
Intelligent stuff from the experienced campaigner. Iqbal gently taps the length ball adjacent to the pitch and takes a quick single.
Shortish ball again, Haque punches it off the back foot and takes a single through wide mid on.
In line of the stumps, on a length, flicked to short mid-wicket for no run.
Too straight on the hips, the ball flicks off the thigh pad to the keeper. Holder appeals but the umpire is not interested.
A back of a length ball, kept out to the off side.
Tamim shoulders arms to let that one through.
On middle and leg, pushed to the on side for nothing.
FOUR! What sound off the bat, Iqbal. Beauty! A mere to the fuller ball outside off and it races through covers for consecutive boundary.

FOUR! Shot! Easy peasy for Iqbal. A fullish ball on the pads and its all too easy for the left-hander to clip it through deep backward square leg. The fielder at fine leg runs to his right but can't cut it off even after putting in a dive.
Short around off, cut to the backward point fielder for nothing.
Iqbal defends it from within the crease and keep it away.
A back of a length outside off, kept out off the back foot.
Fuller outside off, Iqbal punches it off the back foot down the ground and changes strike.
Too wide to entice Iqbal with a shot.
Wide! The ball is way wide on the leg side but Tamim still goes after it and misses. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Fullish on off, driven down the ground for no run.
Wide outside off stump, Iqbal leaves it alone.
On middle and off from Holder, played to the on side for nothing.
Outside off, on a length, ignored by Haque to end the over.
On middle and leg, Haque misses the flick and gets hit on the pads.
Anamul has punched the ball off the back foot.
Angled across outside off, left alone.
On a length and in line of the stumps, clipped through mid-wicket by Haque for a couple.

He hasn't been able to get his rhythm right as of now to the left-hander. Again errs on the pads and Iqbal easily flicks it through square leg. Three runs are taken. A left-right combination is always a difficult pairing to bowl to.
FOUR! Shot! Crisp! It's all timing here. A short ball with a lot of width, Haque punches it off the back foot and gets it through cover-point for the first boundary of their innings.
Ooh! Just outside off this. A length ball coming in with the seam and hits Haque on his pads as he misses the clip. No harm done in the end.
A touch short, blocked off the back foot for nothing.
On a length on off, defended off the front foot by Haque.
Outside off, left alone.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Jason Holder to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
On the pads once again, Iqbal flicks it through square leg and takes a brace. An interesting first over.
Haque pulls the short ball towards fine leg. It goes high in the air and straight into the hands of the fielder there but it's a Free Hit so no harm done. One run added to the total.

No ball! Goodness me? What happened there? He loses the ball from his hand in his followthrough and it goes straight into the hands of second slip. No ball signalled by the umpire. A Free Hit coming up next.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Again on the pads, and again Tamim misses the flick. The ball rolls to fine leg as it clips Tamim's pads. One run taken.
Leg Bye! Errs in line once again and dishes it on the pads. It flicks the pad to the keeper as Iqbal misses the flick again. A leg bye stolen.
Fuller around off, pushed to point off the front foot.
Wide! Starts with a full delivery down the leg side. Tamim misses the flick and wide signalled by the umpire. First runs on the board.
We are all set to go. The players are on the field. Tamim Iqbal and Anamul Haque is the opening duo for Bangladesh. Sheldon Cottrell will take the new ball for Windies. Here we go...

Windies captain, Jason Holder says that they are happy bowling first. Adds that there is always something on this track for the bowlers. Mentions that they need to bat well and chase down the total. States that the guys are charged up and are looking forward to give their best. Informs there are two changes - Kieran Powell comes in place of Jason Mohammed and Alzarri Joseph makes way for Sheldon Cottrell.

Bangladesh captain, Mashrafe Mortaza, says they would like to bat first and put on a good total on a good looking track. Adds that the ground looks small so they are hoping to make the most of it. Ends by saying that they remain unchanged.
Toss - Bangladesh win the toss and choose to bat.

Pitch report - Jeff Dujon reports from the pitch and says the surface is hard and the bounce will be consistent. Adds that there will be good assistance for the spinners. Asserts that due to the hardness of the track, the batsmen will enjoy batting on it. Further asserts that due to the wind blowing across the ground and shortish boundaries, it will be a challenge for the bowlers. Ends by saying that it will be a high scoring match.

On the other hand, the injury to Andre Russell has set the hosts back a bit. However, a century from the young Shimron Hetmyer have given them confidence. This series has been very competitive, full of entertainment and an edge-of-the-seat stuff and even the last match promises to be a thriller. The action starts soon at Warner Park, hang around!

Hello and welcome to the third and final ODI between Windies and Bangladesh in Basseterre, St Kitts. A sunny day welcomes us to the decider of the series. After the last two ODIs, both the teams have looked good in bits & pieces. Visitors' batsmen, especially Shakib Al Hasan has been much better as compared to the home team, however, they couldn't get to the touchline in the previous game.
